_paper_reported_table4._note: Paper Table 4, (sigma_t, sigma_r) = (0.001 m, 1 deg), 100 trials, native scan frames. Missing = zero entries of the n x n measurement matrix. Times in seconds. Context only: the gym pools configurations per graph type, re-expresses every scan in a hidden random frame, and uses its own ICP graphs.

_setup_note: Paper Table 2 uses 100 trials, unconditioned Erdos-Renyi graphs and 15% trimmed means; the gym conditions synthetic graphs on connectivity (disconnected placements are unidentifiable), uses all trials and adds tail metrics. Paper Table 4 uses native scan frames; the gym builds its own ICP graphs (edge counts from the paper's missing rates), re-expresses each scan in a hidden random rigid frame per trial, and pools configurations per graph type. Paper values under keys starting with '_' are historical context, not gym targets. Numeric results below are frozen reproduced measurements on the public train slice (populated by the final reference run).
